They’re looking for an experienced IT Support Team Leader who can bring together the two sides of great MSP leadership – people and technology.

You’ll lead, coach and develop a talented team of engineers while remaining close enough to the technology to support escalations, major incidents and complex customer issues when needed.

This isn’t a role where you’ll spend your entire day buried in spreadsheets, reports and meetings.

You’ll be a visible technical leader within the business, helping engineers develop, improving service delivery, driving accountability and making sure customers receive an exceptional level of support.

⭐ Why This Opportunity Stands Out
  • $90K-$110K Base + Super + Bonus + Training
  • Melbourne - Hybrid working
  • Established and growing Australian MSP/MSSP
  • Genuine investment in leadership and technical development
  • Training and certification support
  • Exposure across Microsoft Cloud, Modern Workplace, infrastructure and security

  • Supportive, people-first culture
  • Strong long-term career progression
If you’re currently working as an MSP Team Leader, Service Desk Team Leader, Senior Engineer or technical lead and want greater ownership of people, performance and service delivery, this could be a fantastic next step.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll take responsibility for the day-to-day leadership and development of the support team while helping ensure technical issues, escalations and major incidents are handled effectively.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Leading, coaching and mentoring your direct reports and the wider support team
  • Running regular 1-on-1s, setting expectations and supporting individual development plans

  • Supporting the onboarding and development of new engineers

  • Coordinating technical resources, customer communication and internal stakeholders during incidents
  • Ensuring incidents and requests are resolved within agreed SLAs
  • Running post-incident reviews and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Using Service Desk metrics and reporting to improve team performance
  • Driving greater proactivity across monitoring, tooling, documentation and support processes
  • Identifying recurring technical issues and helping eliminate root causes
  • Maintaining accurate information within the ITSM platform
  • Working alongside senior engineers, service delivery and technical leadership
  • Assisting with customer service delivery and presales activities when required
What You’ll Bring

This role needs someone who understands that great technical leadership is about more than being the smartest engineer in the room.
You’ll need the technical credibility to support your team, but just as importantly, you’ll enjoy coaching people, solving problems, improving processes and creating a high-performing support environment.

Ideally, you’ll bring:
  • 2+ years' experience leading or mentoring an IT support team, ideally within a Team Leader capacity
  • Recent experience within an MSP, MSSP or Systems Integrator environment
  • Strong hands-on technical troubleshooting skills
  • Experience managing technical escalations and major incidents
  • A good understanding of ITIL principles and service management
  • Experience using Service Desk metrics to manage performance, output and quality
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM / ticketing platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience conducting 1-on-1s, coaching engineers and managing performance
  • A genuine interest in developing technical people
  • A proactive mindset towards service improvement and automation
  • The ability to remain calm and organised when things get busy
Technology Environment

You don’t need to be an expert in every technology, but you’ll need a strong technical foundation across modern MSP environments.
You’ll work with technologies including:
  • Microsoft 365
  • Azure
  • Entra ID
  • Intune / Autopilot
  • Windows Server
  • VMware and virtualisation
  • Networking
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery
  • Modern Workplace
  • ITSM and monitoring platforms
  • Microsoft security technologies
  • Scripting and automation
  • SharePoint and Teams
  • Cloud and infrastructure environments
⭐ What's In It For You?

Step into genuine technical leadership – Lead and develop engineers while remaining connected to the technology and customers.

$90K-$110K Base + Super + Bonus – A strong package with additional incentives and investment in your development.

Training and certifications – Continue developing technically and professionally with structured training and certification support.

Build a high-performing team – Coach engineers, improve performance, develop future senior engineers and help create an environment where people genuinely want to work.

Make an impact – This isn't simply about keeping the lights on. You'll have the opportunity to improve processes, tools, monitoring, documentation and the overall way the support function operates.

Modern technology exposure – Continue building your knowledge across Microsoft Cloud, Modern Workplace, infrastructure, networking, automation and security.

Career progression – Develop towards broader opportunities across Service Delivery, Technical Operations, Service Management, Technical Leadership and senior operational roles.

Supportive, people-first culture – Join an environment that genuinely invests in its people, encourages development and recognises great work.

Hybrid working – Enjoy flexibility while still being part of a collaborative Melbourne-based technical team.

If you love technology but have discovered that you get just as much satisfaction from helping other engineers become better at what they do, this could be a cracking opportunity.

This is your chance to lead from the front, develop a talented team and have a genuine influence on how an MSP delivers great service!
